solves: Says why an area has no content to show and what the person can do, with an illustration, a heading that says what is missing and an optional description that says what to do.
use_when: When a list or a search has no result: the heading says what is missing and the description suggests another search.
When an area still has no content: the heading says what is missing.
When there is nothing to suggest: leave the description empty and show only the heading.
Write the heading as what is missing, because the person understands at once why the area is empty.
Use the description to say what to do, because the empty state becomes a next step.
do_not_use_when: While the content loads: use the loading state of the piece that receives it, such as state=carregando in the nph-combobox list, or nph-skeleton.
To say what failed: use the error message of the piece.
To offer an action: the piece has no button and no link.

heading.constraint: What is missing, already localized by the consuming application. It is the Figma property título. The name is not title, the global HTML attribute, which the browser would show as a native tooltip. Empty or only spaces draws nothing and emits console.error in development.

description.constraint: What the person can do, already localized. It is the Figma property descrição. The Figma boolean texto da descrição is not a property: the description shows when it is not empty and is left out when it is empty or only spaces.

default.changes_for_user: The illustration, the heading and, when given, the description; the piece does not change with interaction.

business_rules: The heading is always present and says what is missing.
The description is optional and says what to do; it never repeats the heading.
The illustration switches by itself with the color scheme, through scheme/is-light and scheme/is-dark; it is never chosen by hand.
The piece has no action: no button and no link.
The piece that receives the nph-empty gives the background and the position; the nph-empty gives only its own inner space.
Loading is the state of the piece that receives it, not of the nph-empty.
ai_hints: Use nph-empty when a list, a search or an area has no content to show; while the content loads, use the loading state of the piece that receives it.
Write the heading as what is missing, such as No option found, never a vague word such as Empty.
Use the description to say what to do; when there is nothing to suggest, leave it empty.
Do not put a button or a link inside or next to the piece as part of it: the piece has no action.
Do not choose the illustration: it follows data-nph-color-scheme.

accessibility.semantics: The host has no role. The heading and the description are paragraphs of text and are read; the illustration is decorative, with an empty `alt` and `aria-hidden`. Announcing that a search found nothing belongs to the piece that receives the nph-empty.
accessibility.focus: The piece does not receive focus: it has no action.
accessibility.contrast: The heading and the description pass 4.5:1 on color/background and on color/popover, in light and dark.
accessibility.color_alternative: The message is in the text of the heading. The illustration only reinforces what the text says.

invalid_combinations: No heading — the piece draws nothing and emits console.error in development.
A description that repeats the heading — use it to say what to do, or leave it empty.
A button or a link as part of the piece — it has no action.
anti_patterns: Writing a vague heading, such as Empty, instead of saying what is missing.
Repeating the heading in the description.
Using the nph-empty while the options load.
Choosing the illustration by hand instead of letting it follow the color scheme.
